newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Charge dropped for Kiwi air ticket holders.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Charge dropped for Kiwi air ticket holders.

text.p: The A$27 passenger movement charge would be dropped for holders of Kiwi International Airlines pre-paid tickets or coupons who buy a ticket with another airline to the same destination, Customs Minister Geoff Prosser said.

"The Finance Minister John Fahey had approved the waiving of the A$27 PMC for Kiwi ticket holders who rebooked tickets, even though the government had not received the original amount collected by the liquidated airline," Prosser said in a statement. Kiwi International was voluntarily liquidated on September 9. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
